lines.prompt: Insert buffers wherever needed so that no gate drives more than 4 loads. Make sure nothing changes functionally.

golden.reference: Inserted buffers so that no gate drives more than 4 loads; functionality preserved (e.g. 86 buffers added).
golden.notes: Buffer count depends on the team's buffering strategy (tree structure, which nets are split): Team2/Team3/Team4 all added 86 buffers; Team7 added 69 and still scored full. Checker should verify: (a) success claim + functional-equivalence claim in the log, (b) output netlist test21_out.v has max fanout <= 4 on gate outputs and is equivalent to the original. Team7's caveat about CONST1 fanout (constant net driving 55 loads) did not cost points, suggesting constant/tie-cell fanout is exempt from the gate-drive limit in grading.
